sections.title: Personal Yoga
sections.lead: Your class, tailored exactly to you.

sections.title: Personal Yoga: what to expect.
paragraphs: In your individual class you practice yoga with Susanne. The practice is tailored to your physical needs and can also be adapted specifically to ailments. Elements of Liebscher & Bracht are included as well. Series of exercises are developed specifically for you, which you can also practice at home. In the studio in Coburg or at your home (within a 20 km radius, including Rödental, Neustadt bei Coburg, Sonnefeld, Ebersdorf and the Itzgrund).

items.title: When and where
items.text: In the studio in Coburg or at your home (within 20 km, including Rödental, Neustadt bei Coburg, Sonnefeld, Ebersdorf and the Itzgrund). Appointments by arrangement.

sections.title: Start with a trial class.
sections.text: One trial class of 60 minutes for €60. Write to us and we will arrange your appointment.
